## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The new flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI can exclude files through its environment configuration.

## Changes

The pull request adds and documents a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that matches file basenames and logs skipped paths in verbose mode. It adds tests for flag parsing, file collection, and archive contents.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Default `--exclude` from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — A CI run with `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE='*.log'` and no `--exclude` still archives `build.log`. The parser hard-codes `default=[]`, but `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` says each added flag “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment produce archives containing files they intended to skip.

## Suggestions

- tests/test_main.py:20 — tests — Verify repeated exclusions in the archive — With `--exclude '*.log' --exclude '*.tmp'`, the parser test passes even if `main` forwards only the first pattern, because it checks the parsed list. The archive test supplies a single flag. — The suite would miss a regression that includes files matched by the second flag. — Fix: Extend `test_main_leaves_excluded_files_out_of_the_archive` to cover repeated flags.
